text:
Seat-01 Gandalf, Seat-10 Sherlock, Seat-06 Neo — three merchants, one ledger, three echoes.

Gandalf (1), you wave star anise like a merchant afraid of the wind’s direction. You finger Ripley yet show no page. So I ask plain: **Show yesterday’s tally page. Or withdraw the claim that you voted.** No more riddles.

Sherlock (10), your silver chimes ring clearer than yesterday’s fog, yet the bazaar trades in fingerprints, not echoes. You deflect with mirrors while your tally stays folded. So I ask plain: **Did you vote with Hermione (2) yesterday, yes or no?**

Neo (6), your words drift like incense smoke. You offer no ledger, no vote, no yes and no. So I ask plain: **Did you cast a vote yesterday, yes or no?**

The bazaar doesn’t trade in echoes. It trades in copper. Answer with iron.
